title: Priority Pickup Charging and the Wayfare Pass Monthly Allowance
content:
Priority Pickup is an add-on to a request on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**.

## Terms

- Priority Pickup is charged only on a completed trip, as the trip's system record shows; a cancelled or unfulfilled request with Priority Pickup is never charged for it.
- It can be added only to ride options on which Priority Pickup is offered, at the ride option's Priority Pickup charge.
- When the rider's Wayfare Pass membership is in trial, active or pending cancellation status and its Priority Pickup allowance for the calendar month (the Pass plan's Priority Pickups per month) is not used up, no charge is made, and one waiver entry for the Priority Pickup charge with basis *Pass Priority Pickup* is written instead.
- The monthly allowance is counted as the waiver entries of basis Pass Priority Pickup on the same membership whose date falls in the calendar month, in market local time, that contains the completed trip being charged.

## Outcomes on a request with Priority Pickup

| Trip outcome | Pass membership in trial, active or pending cancellation, allowance not used up | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Completed | Yes | no charge; one Pass Priority Pickup waiver entry |
| Completed | No | Priority Pickup charged at the ride option's charge |
| Cancelled or unfulfilled | either | never charged for Priority Pickup |

## Example (hypothetical allowance of 2 per month)

A member with an active membership completes three trips with Priority Pickup in one calendar month. The first two are written as Pass Priority Pickup waivers; by the third the two waivers already written in that month use up the allowance, so the third is charged.
